price_semantics: Protocol/DON reference prices and OHLC; not an executable order book
lineage_group: gains_don_reference; do not treat pair price as venue book depth
decision_note: Good high-frequency reference lane. Never label as BidAsk or block-size VWAP.

price_semantics: Native offchain order book/trades; instrument types PERPETUAL and OPTION; USD prices and contract amounts
lineage_group: aevo_native_book; options and perps separate from external index/oracle lineage

price_semantics: Public REST depth/trades/tickers/funding and WebSocket market streams; separate mark/index where exposed

documented_rights_text: No for the documented display endpoints; explicit display-only wording
decision_note: Partner, do not scrape. Treat soft quote as non-binding and display price as reference-only.

decision_note: Not a lawful replacement input for Blocksize analytics/oracle under the cited US NBBO terms. Could be an execution/partner display lane only under a negotiated agreement.

price_semantics: Platform/API and smart-contract solution for issuance/trading; no public price/NAV feed contract located in reviewed official docs

decision_note: Use as issuer/TA integration, not as a generic price provider. Request exact NAV/webhook fields and rights per fund.

price_semantics: Official daily NAV, shares, AUM, accruals, performance and holdings; separate subscription/redemption/order workflows and WTGXX 24/7 dealer settlement
lineage_group: wisdomtree_official_nav; dealer execution and official NAV are distinct semantics but same issuer family
decision_note: High-value partner target: official identifiers and NAV history exist. Keep official NAV separate from 24/7 dealer quote/executable price.

lineage_group: superstate_nav; continuous extrapolation and daily Chainlink/Pyth representations remain one issuer-NAV lineage
decision_note: Strong authoritative NAV/redemption-rate lane. Label continuous price as extrapolated NAV, not an exchange price.

lineage_group: franklin_transfer_agent_nav; all chain deployments are one fund/TA source
decision_note: Partner for official NAV/TA data. Token balance and daily yield minting are not standalone market prices.

price_semantics: NAV per token; onchain price oracle used for subscriptions; daily/monthly administrator NAV; no executable market depth
lineage_group: openeden_fund_nav; administrator report and onchain oracle are one fund lineage
decision_note: Authoritative NAV candidate only. Preserve valuation date and do not infer continuous executable liquidity from 24/7 contract settlement.

price_semantics: Issuer mint/redeem quote and reserve/transparency data; XAUm unit is one troy ounce; no public general price API found

decision_note: Reference/primary quote candidate after exact contract mapping. Website quote is not evidence of API/redistribution rights.

lineage_group: midas_reference_oracle; verification agent and issuer oracle are not separate price sources

documented_rights_text: Unknown for a commercial offchain API built from Pyth
decision_note: Good reference/guardrail input, not block-size VWAP. Treat publisher count as robustness metadata, not accessible independent inputs.

lineage_group: pyth_pro_aggregate; correlated with Pyth Core where same publisher set/instrument
decision_note: Potential partner substitute for client-used TradFi symbols, but obtain written redistribution, raw retention and onchain-publication rights. Experimental bid/ask is not production depth.

price_semantics: Publisher claims real-time feeds and 24/7 commodity coverage; Pyth announced NOBI contributes proprietary data. Exact aggregation and upstream construction are not public
lineage_group: nobi_proprietary; if observed only inside Pyth aggregate, cannot be counted separately
decision_note: Do not infer how NOBI licenses or derives TradFi data. Public evidence does not establish reproducible upstream lineage or copyable rights.

lineage_group: ttmzero_evaluated; Pyth observation is not independent from direct TTMzero for overlapping instruments
decision_note: Plausible partner for evaluated TradFi prices, but methodology, source list, licenses and rights are contract-specific. Do not copy or infer upstream arrangements.

price_semantics: Aggregated market-representative reference or issuer/fundamental/hybrid SmartData; push heartbeat/deviation; not executable depth
lineage_group: chainlink_aggregate; SmartData/NAV must keep issuer administrator lineage; multiple chain deployments are not independent
decision_note: Strong reference/NAV source. Never label as executable; verify heartbeat, deviation, session and deprecation state per exact feed.

price_semantics: Low-latency pull reports; prices, market status and some liquidity-weighted bid/ask; not a full L2 book
